generation.lead: Paint ONE small square illuminated miniature whose single subject is
generation.prompt: Style: same style and palette as the reference picture, 14th-century French Gothic manuscript illumination (enluminure gothique française), egg tempera colours, fine black ink outlines, gold leaf highlights, flat diapered azure blue background with small gold patterns. The subject is large, centred and fills about 75 % of the square, with a strong simple silhouette readable at 32 pixels; no crowd, no busy landscape. Period-accurate France and England 1330-1450. No frame, no border, no text, no letters, no captions, no modern elements.
